description: Emulation source code for the AKM09918C sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing register access, I2C transfer handling, and sensor channel simulation.

methods.name: akm09918c_emul_set_reg
methods.description: Sets the value of a register in the emulated sensor.

methods.name: akm09918c_emul_get_reg
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a register from the emulated sensor.

methods.name: akm09918c_emul_reset
methods.description: Resets the emulated sensor registers to default state.

methods.name: akm09918c_emul_handle_write
methods.description: Handles write operations to specific control registers.

methods.name: akm09918c_emul_transfer_i2c
methods.description: Handles I2C transfer messages for the emulated sensor.

methods.name: akm09918c_emul_backend_set_channel
methods.description: Sets the sensor channel data in the emulation.

methods.name: akm09918c_emul_backend_get_sample_range
methods.description: Provides the measurement range and resolution for a sensor channel.
